body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Motorola expects to showcase its new Mobile TV DVBH compatible DH01 device and mobile TV broadcast solutions portfolio at upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. The DH01 is a pocket sized personal media player featuring 4.3-inch screen that supports up to 16 million colors. It also includes a five-minute memory buffer for pause during live TV viewing.
